Lifeway is back at[Erewhon](https://erewhon.com/shop) this fall to delight members with the **Fall In Love Smoothie** starring[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) for a microbiome-loving, nourishing sip that’s perfect for the cozy weather.


## The Fall In Love Smoothie Featuring Lifeway Kefir


Available at Erewhon this October, the Fall In Love Smoothie blends[Lifeway Organic Lowfat Plain Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/organic-plain-lowfat-kefir/) with smooth cold brew, organic pumpkin purée, dates, banana, and warm pumpkin spice seasoning for a seasonal energy lift your autumn routine has been waiting for. Topped with a dairy cold foam and cinnamon, every sip tastes indulgent and makes any fall day feel extra special.


[Lifeway Organic Lowfat Plain Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/organic-plain-lowfat-kefir/) is packed with billions of live[probiotics](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) , complete protein, calcium, vitamin D, and more. It’s also lactose intolerant friendly, gluten-free, and contains no added sugar. With a wonderfully creamy texture, it makes smoothies like this Fall In Love Smoothie a delicious way to show your gut some love and treat yourself to something special, too.


Check out the full details below, and[visit your local Erewhon](https://ship.erewhon.com/pages/location) to enjoy this smoothie with us!
